image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront featuring a large, multi-pane glass display window filled with various baked goods. Above the window is a blue sign with white cursive text that appears to be in a non-Latin script or stylized font, flanked by decorative painted panels. To the right of the window, there is a mural or poster depicting a person holding bread. The building facade above the shop signage shows exposed brickwork and windows. A pedestrian stands on the sidewalk to the right, partially obscuring the mural.

artifact_observations.location: Blue sign above the display window
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the main blue sign is illegible and structurally nonsensical. It resembles a script but fails to form coherent characters or words, a common AI artifact when generating text-heavy signs.

The depiction of the person holding bread on the right side has a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth texture compared to the photorealistic window reflection, suggesting a potential inconsistency in rendering style or a flat mural that blends oddly with the 3D scene.
Some vertical mullions in the display window appear slightly uneven or warped, lacking the perfect straightness expected of rigid architectural elements, though this is subtle.

To verify the spatial relationship between the glass, the reflections, and the interior shelves, ensuring no 'melting' of depth layers.
To check if individual pastries/breads have distinct boundaries or if they merge into each other (fusion artifact).

Structural integrity of window frames and mullions
